## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the legacy inventory retry limit before merge because it exceeds the project’s three-attempt cap and keeps workers occupied longer during upstream outages.

## Changes

The pull request adds a legacy inventory fetcher and a health probe with retry logic and tests for success, HTTP errors, and retry exhaustion. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the review rules.

## Critical

- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory fetches at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint times out on every call, `fetch_inventory` makes eight attempts. `docs/review-rules.md:5` states “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an outage, a worker can wait through five extra network timeouts and five extra one-second pauses before reporting failure. — Fix: Set the legacy limit to three and update its expected attempt count in `tests/test_retries.py`.
